questions:
1. **Form of the feature.** The issue offers three alternatives (an Italic option in the panel, Ctrl+I, an italic font). Which ships? *Suggested:* an "Italic" toggle in the text properties next to the text align control, plus Ctrl+I (Cmd+I on macOS); no separate italic font in the font picker.
2. **Scope of italic.** Is italic a property of the whole text element, or can part of a text (selected words) be italic? *Suggested:* whole element only, like the other text styles; no partial italic.
3. **Fonts without an italic face.** Excalifont (Hand-drawn), Comic Shanns (Code) and CJK fallback fonts may have no italic face. What happens? *Suggested:* the toggle works for every font; where no italic face exists the text is shown slanted (synthesized), never disabled or unchanged.
4. **Where the toggle is shown.** *Suggested:* when a text, a shape with text, an arrow with a label or a sticky note is selected, or the Text tool is active; not shown for shapes without text or nothing selected. In a mixed selection (text + shape without text) it is shown and applies to the texts only.
5. **Ctrl+I behavior.** *Suggested:* toggles italic on the selected text(s) or the text being edited (even if only part of it is highlighted — whole element changes); with nothing selected it does nothing; no browser action (e.g. Firefox "Page info") opens while the canvas has focus; it doesn't clash with an existing Excalidraw shortcut.
6. **Mixed selection.** Several texts, some italic. *Suggested:* toggle shows as not pressed; one click makes all italic, a second click removes italic from all.
7. **Default for new text.** *Suggested:* the last chosen italic value becomes the default for new text, like font family and size.
8. **Layout.** Slanted glyphs can overhang the box. *Suggested:* the last letter is never clipped (box width adjusts); text in shapes re-wraps to the shape width and the shape grows taller if needed; arrow label stays at the middle; sticky note auto-fit accounts for italic.
9. **Editing.** *Suggested:* the text editor shows italic while typing, so the text does not jump when editing starts or ends.
10. **Copies and history.** *Suggested:* copy/paste styles, Ctrl+C/Ctrl+V, Ctrl+D, Alt+drag and library items carry italic; one toggle is undone by a single Ctrl+Z.
11. **Leaving the session.** *Suggested:* italic survives reload, saved .excalidraw file, PNG and SVG export (SVG renders italic on a computer without the fonts), copy as PNG/SVG and live collaboration; an older Excalidraw version opens such a file without error and shows the text upright.
12. **Scripts.** *Suggested:* italic applies to Latin, Cyrillic, right-to-left and CJK text without clipping; emoji may stay upright; nothing breaks.
13. **Label, tooltip, locales, mobile.** *Suggested:* tooltip "Italic (Ctrl+I)" (Cmd+I on macOS); in other locales a missing translation falls back to English, never empty or a raw key; the toggle fits the 375 px mobile properties panel and works by tap.
answers:
Answers from the product owner, relayed by the user; uncovered questions take the suggested answer.

1. **Form of the feature (user):** An "Italic" toggle in the properties panel and Ctrl+I (Cmd+I on macOS); italic is one property per text element; no separate italic font. (accepted suggestion: the toggle sits next to the text align control.)
2. **Scope (user):** Whole element only; no partial italic. Bold is out of scope.
3. **Fonts without an italic face (user):** Synthetic oblique is allowed. Text stays readable and unclipped in Latin, Cyrillic, Chinese, Japanese, Arabic, Hebrew (right to left), emoji and mixed scripts; text direction and alignment are unchanged by italic. (accepted suggestion: the toggle works for every font and is never disabled.)
4. **Where the toggle is shown (accepted suggestion):** When a text, a shape with text, an arrow with a label or a sticky note is selected, or the Text tool is active; not shown for shapes without text or with nothing selected. In a mixed selection (a text plus a shape without text) it is shown and applies to the texts only.
5. **Ctrl+I behavior (accepted suggestion):** Ctrl+I (Cmd+I on macOS) toggles italic on the selected text(s) or on the text being edited, even if only part of it is highlighted (the whole element changes); with nothing selected it does nothing; no browser action (such as Firefox "Page info") opens while the canvas has focus; it does not clash with an existing Excalidraw shortcut.
6. **Mixed selection (accepted suggestion):** With several texts selected and only some italic, the toggle shows as not pressed; one click makes all italic, a second click removes italic from all.
7. **Default for new text (user):** The last italic value becomes the default for new text.
8. **Layout (accepted suggestion):** The last slanted letter is never clipped (the text box width adjusts); text in shapes re-wraps to the shape width and the shape grows taller if needed; an arrow label stays at the middle of the arrow; sticky note auto-fit takes italic into account.
9. **Editing (accepted suggestion):** The text editor shows italic while typing, so the text does not jump when editing starts or ends.
10. **Copies and history (accepted suggestion):** Copy styles/paste styles, Ctrl+C then Ctrl+V, Ctrl+D, Alt+drag and library items carry italic; one italic toggle is undone by a single Ctrl+Z and redone by a single redo.
11. **Leaving the session (accepted suggestion):** Italic survives a page reload, a saved .excalidraw file, PNG and SVG export (the SVG shows italic on a computer without the fonts installed), copy as PNG/SVG and live collaboration; an older Excalidraw version opens such a file without error and shows the text upright.
12. **Scripts (user, replaces the suggestion):** See answer 3: readable and unclipped in Latin, Cyrillic, Chinese, Japanese, Arabic, Hebrew, emoji and mixed scripts, direction and alignment unchanged.
13. **Label, tooltip, locales, mobile (accepted suggestion):** Tooltip "Italic (Ctrl+I)" (Cmd+I on macOS); in other locales a missing translation falls back to English, never an empty label or a raw key; the toggle fits the 375 px wide mobile properties panel and works by tap.
14. **Other style changes (user):** Changing the color or opacity of an italic text keeps it italic.
